request_text:
Execute mission step contract plan-review (plan/review).
Step record_outcome: Record the review outcome and advance the mission loop
Step guidance: A plan mission has no work packages, so there is no task to move to `approved` and no pre-review gate. Advance the loop with `spec-kitty next --result success` when the plan passes, or `spec-kitty next --result blocked` with a reason when it does not.
